album.title: you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love [Explicit]

wiki.summary: ‘expectations’ is the twelfth track off Olivia Rodrigo’s third studio album, ‘you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love’. The song describes Rodrigo’s self-development and learning to not pick slim pickins when it comes to dating, prioritizing herself over men. Compared to any other track on the album, Olivia Rodrigo never teased this song with a shirt, snippet, live performances, etc. The title was officially announced on May 26th, 2026 and eventually released on June 12th, 2026, along with the rest of the album. Read more on Last.fm.
